diagnosis: The view retrieves sensitive draft checkout sessions directly from the low-level cache using a predictable cart_id path parameter. It never verifies that cached_cart['user_id'] matches request.user.id, allowing any authenticated user to inspect other shoppers' shipping addresses, billing info, and payment gateway tokens.
exploit_request:
GET /api/checkout/session/cart_10928/ HTTP/1.1
Host: store.ecommerce.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
